description.value:
Applied by The Long Toll to yourself.

A lingering unease from the asking -- a −1 status penalty to Will saves. Ends after your next full night's rest; remove this effect manually at that point.

cinderfall.incomplete: The FlatModifier itself is a real, precedented shape (selector:"will" is a confirmed-real selector, e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/goloma/level-1/goloma-courage.json). The card's own text says this penalty lasts "until your next full night's rest" -- pf2e's real duration.unit enum (pf2e-source/src/module/item/abstract-effect/values.ts) has no rest-linked unit, only days/encounter/hours/minutes/rounds/unlimited, so this uses unlimited (a real, precedented choice -- 44 real pf2e-source spell-effects use it) with manual removal on rest, the same way every other homebrew until-a-condition-is-met effect in this corpus is handled (descriptive text, not an automated duration check). The Q&A-about-the-future half of the spell is a separate, correctly-SKIPPED real precedent (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/rituals/commune.json, rules: []).
